            dx = (delta_x > 0) - (delta_x < 0)

        else:
            # No resources; random movement or stay
            dx, dy = 0, 0

    elif game_type == 'pursuit_evasion':
        # Pursue the target if possible
        target = observation.get('target_position', None)
        if target:
            delta_x = target[0] - x
            delta_y = target[1] - y
            dx = (delta_x > 0) - (delta_x < 0)
            dy = (delta_y > 0) - (delta_y < 0)
        else:
            dx, dy = 0, 0

        # Move toward the center or move to explore
        # For simplicity, move toward origin (0,0) to try to centralize control
        delta_x = -x

        dx, dy = 0, 0
